definitions.explanation: Money deposited with the court to secure the temporary release of a person awaiting trial.

examples.japanese: {保釈金|ほしゃくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
{保釈金|ほしゃくきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一千万円|いっせんまんえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Bail was set at ten million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出廷|しゅってい}⟦しなかった→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{保釈金|ほしゃくきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{没収|ぼっしゅう}→没収：18517_bosshuu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If the defendant fails to appear in court, the bail money is forfeited.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{保釈|ほしゃく}→保釈：22384_hoshaku⟧ (bail/release on bail) and {金|きん} (money). In Japan, bail is granted much less frequently than in many Western countries. Japan's criminal justice system has a very high conviction rate, and suspects are often detained throughout the investigation and trial process. When bail is granted, the amounts can be substantial — often tens of millions of yen for serious cases.

The {保釈金|ほしゃくきん} is returned if the defendant complies with all bail conditions and appears for trial.
